integrity: The formulas were reconstructed directly from the source's displayed threshold functional. A constant-parameter witness gives an exact regime reversal and a direct cycle-contraction proof, independent of numerical simulation. Searches for exact-title/DOI corrections and semantically equivalent threshold claims found no covering correction. A highly relevant predecessor was inspected at abstract level; a failed full-text retrieval returned unrelated material and was excluded from evidence. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the explicit harvesting threshold formulas and an associated equality in the local-stability calculation. The closed-season identity is generally implicit for time-varying catchability. No claim is made about separate hypotheses for root existence, other applications in the paper, or the correctness of the abstract theorem when it is stated in terms of the actual zero of \(\digamma\).
title: Two missing scale factors reverse the printed fishery threshold calibration
